subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Should OpenClaw support status visibility controls, and if so should the canonical behavior be per-agent section filtering, a whole-card format toggle, or no new configuration?
rationale: The request adds core configuration and changes how operational and potentially sensitive usage data is exposed across chat and tool boundaries; source inspection cannot determine the intended trust model or output contract.

options.title: Per-Agent Section Policy
options.body: Add a default-preserving per-agent allowlist or denylist for status sections while retaining structured tool details and applying the same policy consistently to visible text.

options.title: Whole-Card Format Toggle
options.body: Add a simpler global or agent-default text-versus-structured toggle, accepting less granular privacy control and broader presentation changes.

options.title: Keep Current Contract
options.body: Reject additional configuration and continue treating the complete human-readable card as the required output of both status surfaces.

recommendation.title: Per-Agent Section Policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-preserving per-agent allowlist or denylist for status sections while retaining structured tool details and applying the same policy consistently to visible text.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across the shared status paths and already supplied product-routing context on this issue.
